verdict.rationale: WooCommerce ships a fully documented REST API (v3, JSON, versioned endpoints, key management with scoped read/write access), plus official client libraries in JS/PHP/Python/Ruby, a Store API for cart/checkout, webhooks for event-driven integration, and a WC-CLI for command-line control — collectively giving AI-native users multiple documented, public, programmatic ways to drive the product. It also documents native MCP support, further tailoring the API surface for AI assistants. Missing for 10: no published OpenAPI/swagger spec was found (probe returned 404s) and no independent hands-on corroboration of API robustness beyond vendor docs.
